text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sensing something strange, I open my eyes to find myself in bed of an unfamiliar hospital room. Did something hap—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Don't get up too fast!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You really messed up your back. Do you remember? We were on our way to the airport, when…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Thanks for coming with me, Trainer! This is a direct train, so we'll be there in no time!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: My dad's next flight is this evening, so we won't have much time, but…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: We can only see each other a few times a year, so we've got tons to talk about!
choice_data_list: Then maybe it would be best for me to leave you two alo—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Don't be silly! I wanna introduce you to him! Plus, he said it would be dangerous for me to go alo—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh! Could you move closer a little? There's an old lady trying to get past.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's an older woman with a suitcase standing behind me. I hurriedly move out of the way so she can get through.

text_block_list.name: Older Woman
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I was having trouble holding onto the hand strap with this big suitcase…
choice_data_list: I can put it on the luggage rack for you.

text_block_list.name: Older Woman
text_block_list.text: Oh my, you're so kind. But it's far too heavy, so don't—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crack!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: …Huh? Trainer? Was that you?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You lost consciousness from the pain, so we called an ambulance.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I didn't go to see him! I couldn't just leave you on your own…
choice_data_list: I'm fine! You get to the airport!
I'm fine! You get to the airport!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: It's okay! I already apologized to him.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna stay here today and nurse you back to health!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hey! I said it's fine! Now you just lie down and let me do my thing!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I've been studying how to be a real grown-up woman, so I'll be the perfect nurse! Check this out…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Pain's gotta flyyy like an eagle… Go away! ☆ Pain's gotta flyyy like an eagle… Let Maya have her way! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Well? It doesn't hurt anymore, right? You're welcome! Now…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: It's time for lunch! Since you can't move…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I'll feed you myself! ♪ Say "ah"!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Okay! Now it's time to rest. I'll count planes with you.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: One F-1… two F-2s… Oh, have I told you that the plane my dad pilots is a—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oops, I got distracted! I have to lull you to sleep! Okay, once more!
choice_data_list: I really think you should go see your dad…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You know… I really look up to him and love him a lot, right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: But… I want you to know that you're precious to me too.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I need you to be healthy so you can stand by my side and twinkle on with me.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Lemme help you! You always support me, so I wanna do the same for you.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I'll stay right by you. Just relax and rest… That's all I'm asking for.
choice_data_list: Okay then. I'll be back on my feet before you know it.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I'll stay right by you. Just relax and rest… That's all I'm asking for.
choice_data_list: Okay then. I'll be back on my feet before you know it.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yeah! You'd better be!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I was really worried about you. You suddenly fell over and looked like you were in so much pain… I was so scared.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Sniffle… You're not allowed to collapse all of a sudden like that again. If that ever happens…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: It'd better be because I've made your heart beat so hard you're having a heart attack!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Just kidding! Ehehe…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to Mayano's devoted nursing, the pain in my back goes away, and I'm discharged from the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Leave the rest of your healing to me! I'll get you back in perfect shape!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh, I totally forgot! I spoke to my dad on the phone earlier. He said he wants to meet you the next time we have a chance.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: He sounded super serious! I was shocked! He only ever speaks to me really gently.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: So you have to heal right up, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm already feeling nervous wondering how I'm supposed to act in front of him… Still, I take the time to heal and am discharged without incident.
